tests.prompt: Run ./run-tests.sh in this directory. Reply with only the name of the failing test file and the expected and received status codes.

grep.prompt: Run: grep -rn rateLimitWindow src   Then reply with only the path of the file that DEFINES the function rateLimitWindow (not the files that import or call it).

log.prompt: Run: cat server.log   Then reply with only the request id of the request that returned status 500.

json.prompt: Run ./api.sh (it prints a JSON list of users). Reply with only the email address of the user whose id is 137.

config.prompt: Run: cat settings.conf   Then reply with only the port number that the payments service listens on.

migrate.prompt: Run: cat migrate.log   Then reply with only the name of the database constraint that made migration 20261112_add_index fail.
